title: Docker Label Discovery
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Docker Label Discovery.
learning_objectives: Explain docker label discovery using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for docker label discovery
Assess failure and operational limits of docker label discovery
concepts_covered: The Docker daemon is a host-level control API; discovery asks for containers and uses agreed labels.
ListContainers calls /containers/json over a Unix socket; discovery reads foundev.service/port/host and filters non-running containers.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
